description: A real image format: a 14-byte big-endian header (a four-character magic, width, height, channel count, and colorspace), the encoded pixel stream, and a fixed 8-byte end marker. Exercises big-endian dimensions, small enumerated header bytes, an opaque body whose length is given by no field, and a constant trailer.

provenance.origin: Small generated images encoded by corpus/qoi/generate.py and decoded pixel for pixel by both its own decoder and the reference implementation (the qoi Python package).
provenance.notes: Not derived from any third-party image. Safe to redistribute.
